decisions.reason: As a fashion-sensitive devoré decorative fabric introduced alongside several close alternatives, it has likely revealed enough after three years to justify abandoning this weaker option and reallocating shelf and sampling capacity.

This transparent burnout decorative fabric overlaps with other decorative novelties and, given the firm's multiple 2019 launches, is a relatively expendable option if demand has not clearly emerged by 2022.

A standard burnout decorative fabric is another overlapping collection item whose uncertainty should be largely resolved after several selling seasons, making discontinuation likely unless it became a clear staple.

A velour-like upholstery fabric fits the firm's core upholstery business and can remain a worthwhile option because it is less purely fashion-led and more compatible with repeat orders and stocked supply.

The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric serves a functional, specification-driven need for trade customers, so it is relatively attractive to keep open as a lower-uncertainty, service-supporting product.

The polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a basic complementary item that supports the firm's sewing and made-to-measure capabilities, so keeping it is reasonable unless sales prove persistently thin.
